note: The ad layout, for reference only: the page does not read ads from this file. Ads come only from creatives an advertiser submitted and an admin approved in admin.html (api/_creative.js, served at /api/creative?live=1). 'slots' are the sponsor line at the top of a board (jobs, deals, events, classifieds); 'cards' the one in-listing ad card on each of those boards (after the 6th post, or at the end of a shorter board); 'rails' the side ads on wide screens, shown only on the Events, Jobs, Deals and Classifieds tabs. News/All, News, Police & courts, Obituaries and Breaking have no ads. Every ad is labeled 'Sponsored' and links with rel="sponsored". Our own ads are never targeted: no cookies, no reader data. An empty slot, card or right rail shows the site's own 'Advertise with us' unit, which opens the advertising inquiry form. Keep every value here null or empty.
